function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values, meaning 48 patients appear more than once in the dataset — likely because they were re-tested and thus have two rows with `sample_seq = 1` and `sample_seq = 2`.", "implication": "The population must be one row per patient. We must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient. Otherwise, patients who were re-tested would be double-counted, inflating the total number of patients and potentially biasing the fraction of severe cases if re-testing was non-random."}
function.name: note_finding
